sub_sector.value: microturbine on-site power generation systems; energy-as-a-service and aftermarket service

manufacturing_type.detail: Assembles oil-free microturbine engines into modular multi-bay power systems on core engine platforms.

production_model.detail: Standard engine platforms configured into multi-megawatt systems; also rental and lease fleets.

product_complexity.detail: Engineered fuel-flexible microturbine generators for mission-critical, harsh-environment use.

production_role.detail: Sells finished microturbine systems through distributors, plus service agreements and energy-as-a-service.

end_market_exposure.detail: Oil and gas, data centers, hospitals, agriculture, industrial, EV charging, wastewater and landfill, commercial buildings.
